name: Nitrefazole

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Germany and Austria, first in 1984 — for blood problems and liver harm

summary: Nitrefazole was removed from the market in Germany and Austria starting in 1984 due to liver harm and problems with the blood [3]. In addition, a small computer model estimated the drug's risks, rather than tests done on actual people [M]. This computer model gave it a high score of 90 for liver risk and a low score of 23 for heart risk [M].
